name: Calendar: Remove Imported Feed

description.en: Remove an iCalendar source from this team's imported updates. This stops future imports for that source while preserving the explicit approval step for a destructive configuration change.
description.de: Entfernt eine iCalendar-Quelle aus den importierten Updates dieses Teams. Dadurch werden künftige Importe gestoppt; für diese destruktive Konfigurationsänderung bleibt die explizite Freigabe erhalten.

bot: Use this only after the user explicitly confirms removal of the identified calendar source. List feeds first if necessary; explain that it stops future imports before executing.

inputs.name: Feed ID

description.en: Identifier of the imported calendar source to remove

inputs.bot: The feed ID from list imported calendar feeds. Confirm removal with the user first.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug that owns this calendar source

inputs.bot: The slug of the team that owns this calendar source. Omit it to use the current team.
